consequence.statement: The AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature is now always enabled and can no longer be disabled; environments that previously disabled this feature will have additional certificate output formats enabled by default.
consequence.remediation: Review certificate output formats to ensure they are compatible with downstream consumers. If additional formats cause issues, update consumers or file an issue with cert-manager if the formats are problematic.

assertion.statement: The AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature-gate is promoted to GA and always enabled; it can no longer be disabled via feature-gate configuration.
